text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: On the way back from accompanying Sirius Symboli on a shopping trip.

text_block_list.name: Sirius Symboli
text_block_list.text: What's all the commotion about?

text_block_list.name: Shopping District Local
text_block_list.text:
Step right up, the New Year's Grand Raffle is underway~!
The grand prize is an all-expenses-paid hot springs trip!

text_block_list.name: Shopping District Local
text_block_list.text:
1st prize is the "Special Carrot Hamburg Steak"!
2nd prize is "Mountain of Carrots"!
3rd prize is "Single Carrot"!

text_block_list.name: Shopping District Local
text_block_list.text:
"Step right up, step right up, it's the fun, fun lottery!
Anyone and everyone, come on over!"

text_block_list.name: Sirius Symboli
text_block_list.text:
Huh.
...Come to think of it, I got one earlier.

text_block_list.name: Sirius Symboli
text_block_list.text: No, I'll pass.

text_block_list.name: Sirius Symboli
text_block_list.text:
Go ahead and try.
Let's see just how good your luck really is.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Still, using her lottery ticket felt a bit
wrong. As I hesitated—

text_block_list.name: Sirius Symboli
text_block_list.text:
Don't wet yourself.
Even if you draw a dud, I'm not gonna kick you.
choice_data_list: It's not like that—I want you to draw it.
It's not like that—I want you to draw it.

text_block_list.name: Sirius Symboli
text_block_list.text:
Huh, begging for a favor?
Look who's acting high and mighty now.

text_block_list.name: Sirius Symboli
text_block_list.text: The answer is no. I would find no amusement in it.

text_block_list.name: Sirius Symboli
text_block_list.text:
First of all, this raffle ticket belongs to me.
What I do with it is my own business. Am I wrong?

text_block_list.name: Sirius Symboli
text_block_list.text:
If you get it, grab the lever.
Mister, one try, please.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Before I could say anything back, the handle was thrust into my grip.
Unable to resist, I turned the lottery wheel!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: And the result was—

text_block_list.name: Shopping District Local
text_block_list.text:
Incredible! Congraaaatulations!!
The Grand Prize, 'Hot Springs Trip Ticket', has been won~~~~!!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Acquired "<itemname>".

text_block_list.name: Sirius Symboli
text_block_list.text: ...Heh heh. Ahaha!

text_block_list.name: Sirius Symboli
text_block_list.text:
The grand prize, huh?
Talk about incredible luck.

text_block_list.name: Sirius Symboli
text_block_list.text:
The inn at our destination is fairly well-known, too.
Go and enjoy yourself as much as you like.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Sirius Symboli handed over the "Hot Springs Trip Voucher"
as if it were the most natural thing in the world.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
However, she had drawn it using her own raffle ticket.
I simply couldn't bring myself to accept it.

text_block_list.name: Sirius Symboli
text_block_list.text:
Huh? I said I'm giving it to you.
Shut up and take it.

text_block_list.name: Sirius Symboli
text_block_list.text: ...Sheesh, you leave me no choice.

text_block_list.name: Sirius Symboli
text_block_list.text: Then I'll save it for your reward.

text_block_list.name: Sirius Symboli
text_block_list.text:
Taking care of a pet dog is a master's duty, after all.
I'll give it to you when you need it.

text_block_list.name: Sirius Symboli
text_block_list.text:
Until then, keep wagging your tail and working hard.
Little puppy.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
And so... an unexpected "reward"
ended up being established.

text_block_list.name: Shopping District Local
text_block_list.text:
Congratulations, you won 1st prize~!
The prize is a "Special Carrot Hamburg Steak"!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Acquired "<itemname>".

text_block_list.name: Sirius Symboli
text_block_list.text:
Huh. Not a bad result.
Looking closely, the materials used here are top-notch too.

text_block_list.name: Sirius Symboli
text_block_list.text: Savor every bite.

text_block_list.name: Sirius Symboli
text_block_list.text: ...Unfortunately for you, I'm just a pampered boy from the Symboli family.

text_block_list.name: Sirius Symboli
text_block_list.text: Developing your palate is a far better use of it than me eating it.

text_block_list.name: Sirius Symboli
text_block_list.text:
Yeah, don't you dare forget to report back
on what it was and how good it tasted.

text_block_list.name: Sirius Symboli
text_block_list.text: Cuz you wouldn't learn a damn thing that way.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Afterward, I quietly savored
the "Special Carrot Hamburger Steak"—

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: It was so unbelievably delicious that I couldn't help calling her right then and there to report back.

text_block_list.name: Sirius Symboli
text_block_list.text:
Ahahaha! Ah, was it that delicious?
Well, that's great to hear.

text_block_list.name: Sirius Symboli
text_block_list.text: ...Heh, feeding you is gonna turn into a bad habit if I'm not careful.

text_block_list.name: Shopping District Local
text_block_list.text:
Second prize~!!
The prize is a "Mountain of Carrots"!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Acquired "<itemname>".

text_block_list.name: Sirius Symboli
text_block_list.text: Not bad at all, I'd say.

text_block_list.name: Sirius Symboli
text_block_list.text: A whole mountain of carrots, huh? Ain't no way you're eating all that, are ya?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"It is a shame since I managed to win it, but
I fear some of it might go bad."

text_block_list.name: Sirius Symboli
text_block_list.text:
"I want to avoid excess calorie intake as well.
Pops, sorry, but this is—..."

text_block_list.name: Sirius Symboli
text_block_list.text:
"...No, scratch that.
I just remembered a lead."

text_block_list.name: Sirius's Juniors
text_block_list.text: Is that really okay?!

text_block_list.name: Sirius Symboli
text_block_list.text:
Yeah.
Take as much as you want back with you.

text_block_list.name: Sirius's Juniors
text_block_list.text: Thanks a ton!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Seeing her juniors so happy, Sirius Symboli looked rather satisfied as well.

text_block_list.name: Shopping District Local
text_block_list.text:
3rd prize~!
The prize is "one carrot"!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Acquired "<itemname>".

text_block_list.name: Sirius Symboli
text_block_list.text: Well, I guess that's about it.

text_block_list.name: Sirius Symboli
text_block_list.text:
Still, just one carrot, huh?
I could just hand it over to ya, but...
that'd be boring.

text_block_list.name: Sirius Symboli
text_block_list.text:
Alright.
Show me your cooking skills.

text_block_list.name: Sirius Symboli
text_block_list.text:
Managing nutrition is part of a Trainer's job.
Something like this should be second nature to you.

text_block_list.name: Sirius Symboli
text_block_list.text: If you make it tasty, I'll praise you.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
And so, using just a single carrot,
I had to cook a dish to show her.

text_block_list.name: Sirius Symboli
text_block_list.text: —Huh.

text_block_list.name: Sirius Symboli
text_block_list.text:
Slow. And on top of that, it's undercooked.
Can't say it looks any good, either.

text_block_list.name: Sirius Symboli
text_block_list.text: ...However, the ingredients are put to great use.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: I was wondering how it would turn out, but they seemed reasonably satisfied.

text_block_list.name: Shopping District Local
text_block_list.text:
Too bad, you lost!
Your consolation prize is a pack of tissues~

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Acquired "<itemname>".

text_block_list.name: Sirius Symboli
text_block_list.text: Well, I never had high hopes to begin with.

text_block_list.name: Sirius Symboli
text_block_list.text: Still... I don't really believe in luck or whatever, but—

text_block_list.name: Sirius Symboli
text_block_list.text: Pulling something labeled a "Dud" leaves a pretty bad taste in your mouth, naturally.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Sirius Symboli seemed vaguely downcast...
